title: A naked‐eye, highly sensitive and recyclable cliometric acid–base indicator based on xylenol orange functionalized polyvinyl alcohol fiber
content:
Abstract

In this work, a novel xylenol orange functionalized polyvinyl alcohol fiber (PVAF-XO) was designed and prepared through a simple one-step reaction and characterized using elemental analysis, x-ray powder diffraction (XRD), Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR), and scanning electron microscopy (SEM). The prepared PVAF-XO exhibits excellent sensitivity to acid and base solutions, featuring a remarkable visual color change from pale yellow to orange red (acid) or purple (base) within 1 s. It is shown that PVAF-XO has the advantages of excellent acid–base double response color change, low naked-eye detection limit (8 × 10−4 mol/L), excellent reusability (>500 times), high photostability (90 days) and concentrated acid–base stability, etc. This research is an important exploration for the application of functionalized polyvinyl alcohol fibers to pollution prevention.
